تختزلون (form VIII)
# تَخْتَزِلُونَ (taḵtazilūna) /tax.ta.zi.luː.na/: second-person masculine plural non-past active indicative of اِخْتَزَلَ (iḵtazala)
# تُخْتَزَلُونَ (tuḵtazalūna) /tux.ta.za.luː.na/: second-person masculine plural non-past passive indicative of اِخْتَزَلَ (iḵtazala)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
